description: Is this token safe to buy? Send a token contract address (Base by default; also ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, or a Solana mint), get a short verdict: LOW_RISK, CAUTION or HIGH_RISK, a 0-100 safety score, one plain-language sentence, whether a simulated sale succeeds (honeypot check), observed buy tax, liquidity, who controls the contract and the top three risks. Cheaper and shorter than check_token_risk. Use for a quick safe-to-buy answer; for every check and the raw contract, liquidity and simulation data use check_token_risk.

address.description: 0x-prefixed ERC-20 contract, or a base58 Solana mint

chain.description: Chain of the token or pool: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon (solana where listed). Not the payment network

name: get_token_verdict
